Create NEW original native pixel-art animation drawings for Sonic the Hedgehog, keeping the attached reference's exact Sonic Adventure (1998/1999) identity. The reference is a design reference only: redraw every pose for this new sheet, do not copy or repeat its frames.
Identity lock: cobalt-blue Sonic, six long backward quills in the Adventure silhouette, joined white eye area with GREEN irises, small black nose, peach muzzle/arms/oval chest patch, slim short iconic hedgehog body with oversized head and shoes, white gloves with cuffs, red shoes with a broad WHITE strap and small GOLD buckle. No SOAP shoes, extra clothes, human torso proportions, armor, weapon, gold Super Sonic, seven Emerald transformation, black/red Shadow colors, giant power aura, or Chaos Control.
Native-art output: one transparent RGBA PNG, vertical 1:2 aspect, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT SEPARATE ROWS, exactly THIRTY-TWO complete single-character drawings. Eight states below each get their own full row in the listed order; four columns are four genuinely different sequential anatomical poses. Do not combine states into a row or omit the last row. No labels, numbers, grid lines, background, ground plane, shadow, text, watermark, or duplicate bodies. Every full body/rolled body and complete shoes/quills/gloves stays inside its own cell with visible transparent margin on every side.
Style: crisp highly readable 32-bit pixel clusters, clean dark-blue contour, limited cobalt/peach/red/white palette and consistent lighting. Match the icon proportions of this Sonic rather than a human fighter. Face RIGHT except the deliberate turning row. Keep one consistent physical body size and pixel density throughout the entire sheet: rolling, kneeling, leaning or crouching lowers the silhouette naturally but must not shrink the head, gloves or shoes. Standing recovery and idle have equal bodily stature. No large effects that force a small character.
Spin-ball rule: where a row calls for a curl, draw Sonic's ACTUAL COMPACT ROLLED BLUE SPIKY BODY as the character, with changing anatomical/quill rotation and occasional tucked red shoe or glove details. Four separately drawn rotational poses are required. Never replace Sonic with a smooth glowing circle, outline, speed effect, a body inside an energy sphere, a procedural disk, or four copies of the same ball. No ghost afterimages. All motion must be visible in the actual body drawings.
All guards here are physical evasion or gloved body protection adapted for this fighting-game context, with no magical shield and no claim that these are exact official source-game frames. Clean non-gory knockouts, no wounds and no opponent.

Row 1 / idle: four relaxed Sonic standing poses, weight shift, heel/toe tap, subtle glove/wrist adjustment and head angle. Same full bodily stature, readable calm personality.
Row 2 / walk: a real four-pose alternating footfall cycle: leading right shoe heel plant, centered passing step, opposite shoe heel plant, opposite passing step; arms counter-swing. Body does not slide in four identical drawings.
Row 3 / run: four genuine Adventure Sonic sprint body poses, low forward lean and alternating bent/extended legs with readable red shoes, back quills trailing; no circular leg effect or dust replacing the legs.
Row 4 / turn: start facing LEFT, rotate through back-facing and right three-quarter poses, and FINISH FACING RIGHT. Four different body orientations, not four frontal poses.
Row 5 / jumpStart: standing spring preparation, compressed knees with hands close, feet pushing off with torso folding, then Sonic fully tucked into his actual quilled spin body. Preserve body size through the curl.
Row 6 / jumpRise: four separate compact quilled Sonic spin-ball body drawings with genuinely rotated quill anatomy, tucked shoes/gloves glimpsed in changing positions. No open-legged upright Sonic and no VFX sphere.
Row 7 / jumpApex: four native spin-ball rotations near the apex, slightly loosening the body through quill and shoe/glove positions, still Sonic's actual compact rolled body. No blue circle around a standing Sonic.
Row 8 / fall: Sonic's rolled body begins to unfold, next quills and shoes emerge, next arms/legs extend for landing, final airborne landing-preparation crouch facing right. Four distinct body poses in this eighth row; keep the complete final shoes inside the canvas.
Count audit before finishing: 8 populated horizontal rows × 4 columns = 32 different native drawings. Do not stop at seven rows.

Row 8 / defeat: four defeated/exhausted Sonic body poses: shoulders dropped, one knee lowering, seated/slumped posture looking down, then quiet low seated exhaustion with gloves resting. No victory gesture, no disappearing body and no lethal injury.
